purpose: Define private/self-hosted Hello-compatible rendezvous as an allowed alternative bootstrap service using the same discovery contract without requiring application payload centralization.

topics.name: Private Rendezvous
topics.purpose: Define private/self-hosted Hello-compatible rendezvous as an allowed alternative bootstrap service using the same discovery contract without requiring application payload centralization.

semantics.deployment_rule: Private rendezvous may be deployed where supported.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Private service follows the same canonical bootstrap/discovery contract for compatible peers.
semantics.payload_rule: Private deployment does not change the rule that application payload remains peer-to-peer after establishment.
semantics.identity_rule: Private service instance has its own explicit logical identity.
semantics.binding_rule: Network endpoint is a mutable binding, not service semantic identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Operating a private rendezvous service does not grant authority over connected peer application data.
semantics.interchange_rule: Official/private selection is transport/bootstrap configuration, not peer semantic identity.

invariants.rule: Hello/Rendezvous performs peer discovery/bootstrap only; it never becomes application-payload owner, semantic peer identity, or authorization authority.

hard_gates.condition: private rendezvous owns peer payload semantics
endpoint used as service semantic identity
private relay incompatible semantics accepted silently

references.purpose: Private deployments implement Hello-compatible bootstrap semantics.

prose.summary: Define private/self-hosted Hello-compatible rendezvous as an allowed alternative bootstrap service using the same discovery contract without requiring application payload centralization.
